Class OrganicFoodGrain

java.lang.Object
Crop
FoodGrain
OrganicFoodGrain
public class OrganicFoodGrain extends FoodGrain
Represents an organic food grain, the deepest class in the Multilevel Inheritance chain. Demonstrates Multilevel Inheritance in the Agriculture domain.

Inheritance chain: Crop → FoodGrain → OrganicFoodGrain

Version:
1.0
Author:
Mohammed Faaris Khan

      yieldPerAcre - the yield per acre in quintals
      grainType - the type of grain
      proteinContent - the protein content percentage
